title: Pest Control
description: Grain factor Corrin Dale is losing a sack a night to teeth marks and spoilage, real coin counted out at the till every morning, and the district's own ratcatchers have stopped going past his loading doors - something in there is bigger than a rat should be. He paid the Guild's asking price without argument, which is the whole of Vorn's interest in the job. Clear the warehouse and the fee is yours; leave it, and Corrin's losses keep climbing while the Guild's cut goes unpaid.

objectives.description: Enter Corrin Dale's warehouse, past the doors the ratcatchers won't cross
Kill the rats emptying Corrin Dale's grain stores
Tell Vorn the warehouse is Corrin's again

notes: Rank: Initiate. Easy indoor combat. Teaches dungeon clearing. Rats spawn in Dalhurst warehouse interior. Threat: nightly grain loss to a named factor, Corrin Dale, who the district's ratcatchers have abandoned. Giver motive: Vorn takes any paying contract for a new recruit regardless of size. Consequence: Corrin's losses continue and the Guild's cut goes unpaid - stated in prose, not wired.
